title: Pet Wire Protocol Envelope
description: Common envelope fields carried by every desktop-pet wire protocol event. This scaffold will grow into the full public contract described in docs/adr/0002-pet-wire-protocol.md.

agent.description: Open string naming the source tool, e.g. "dsh", "codex", "claude".

sessionId.description: Session id as scoped by the source tool; desktop pet keys sessions as agent:sessionId.
